record.question: Call me if you need my help. Pick out the correct clause of the underlined words.
record.explanation: Answer B: adverb clause. “If you need my help” states the condition for calling, so it is an adverb clause. Independent check: “If you need my help” gives the condition under which the call should be made; it is adverbial. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conditionals. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
